title: Practice 11: в- and вы-: in, and out

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **выбежали** — past tense (plural) of выбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: выбегать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: The bee flew out of the window.
exercises.why: **вылетела** — past tense (feminine) of вылететь: perfective (imperfective partner: вылетать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Everybody ran out into the hall.
exercises.why: **выбежали** — past tense (plural) of выбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: выбегать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: We leave in half an hour.
exercises.why: **выезжаем** — present tense (1st person plural) of выезжать: imperfective (perfective partner: выехать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: Tom ran out of the classroom.
exercises.why: **выбежал** — past tense (masculine) of выбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: выбегать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: My house faces to the south.
exercises.why: **выходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of выходить: imperfective (perfective partner: выйти).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
**войдите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
**входило** — past tense (neuter) of входить: imperfective (perfective partner: войти).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: It wasn't part of the plan.

exercises.why: **вылезайте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of вылезать: imperfective (perfective partner: вылезть).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

**вылезайте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of вылезать: imperfective (perfective partner: вылезть).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

**вылезайте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of вылезать: imperfective (perfective partner: вылезть).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
**вошла** — past tense (feminine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
**вбежала** — past tense (feminine) of вбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: вбегать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: A mouse came into the room.
